rows.abstract: "The Padrino System Abolition Act of 1999'. This bill seeks to prohibit certain public officials from standing as sponsor in wedding, baptism, confirmation and similar religious rites.  It seeks to put and end to this padrino system to prevent theseofficials from exerting undue influence to favour their godsons or inaanaks and their compadre to the detriment of the government and the Filipino people.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1999-07-13
